messages:
maria.g: FYI CI is failing on the docs site. linkcheck shows a fragment error for security/keys.mdx — looks like an empty slug got generated :facepalm:

bjorn: Can you paste the linkcheck output? quick to triage if it's a bad heading or slugify change.

maria.g: Sure — here's the relevant bit from the build log:
```
ERROR: Broken link '.../security/keys.mdx#' referenced from 'index.html'
  Reason: empty fragment generated for heading on security/keys.mdx
```

jess: Hmm I remember a PR that added a tiny heading in that file earlier today. @maria.g can you check if it was emoji-only? Those can produce weird slugs depending on the slugifier.

maria.g: Looking at the file, the new section had a heading that was literally just an emoji: `## 🔐` — no text. Some slug generators turn that into an empty id.

devx-bot: linkcheck run summary:
- Checked 312 pages
- 1 broken fragment: security/keys.mdx -> generated id '' (empty)

arjun: Quick fixes we can do:
1) change the heading to include text, e.g. `## Key management 🔐`
2) explicitly set an ID: `## {#key-management} 🔐` or `## Key management {#key-management}` depending on MDX markdown extension
3) add a docs lint rule that flags emoji-only headings during PRs

bjorn: Option 2 is safest short-term (explicit id). Patch should be tiny. If someone can open a PR we can unblock the build and then follow up with a linting rule.

maria.g: I'll open a quick PR with the explicit id and run linkcheck locally before pushing. Patch snippet I'm going to use:
```mdx
- ## 🔐
+ ## Key management {#key-management} 🔐
```
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2381 (WIP)

jess: Nice. After that can we add a small CI check? `npm run docs:linkcheck` in CI should fail fast. We can add a grep that fails on headings matching `^#{2,}\s*[\p{Emoji}]` (rough idea) or a remark-lint rule.

olivia: :thumbsup: thanks for moving fast. Also pinging @devx to follow up on adding a lint rule so this doesn't recur.

arjun: For local verification: run `pnpm docs:linkcheck && pnpm docs:build` — that mirrors CI. If someone wants, I can add the lint rule in a follow-up PR after this fix.

maria.g: PR opened and CI re-run — linkcheck passed locally for me. I added a short PR description and noted to follow up with linting.

bjorn: Perfect. Once CI green I'll merge. Thanks for the quick patch. :rocket:
